summary: Learn customer retention and loyalty strategy with CLV, RFM, CRM workflows, and loyalty design. Build retention tools you can use immediately.
lede: Customer retention work combines customer behavior, service feedback, and repeat-purchase measures to spot churn risk and guide loyalty actions. For professionals working with customer data, loyalty programs, or service performance, this course covers RFM and cohort analysis, CLV prioritization, CRM churn-prevention triggers, tiered reward design, service recovery, and KPI dashboard construction.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with customer data, loyalty activity, or service performance and now need a more structured retention approach.
prerequisites: You should have access to a laptop with Excel or Google Sheets and the ability to work with sample customer data or your own organization’s retention reports. Familiarity with CRM concepts, customer segmentation, and basic commercial reporting will help you move faster through the exercises. Participants should be ready to discuss loyalty structures, service recovery examples, and retention metrics from their current work context.
